parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_test_runs (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    run_key UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID(),

    suite_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'running',
                'passed',
                'failed',
                'partial',
                'cancelled'
            )
        ),

    requested_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
    environment_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local',

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    UNIQUE (run_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_test_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    suite_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    case_code TEXT NOT NULL,

    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            category IN (
                'conversation',
                'gateway_security',
                'appointments',
                'patient_consent',
                'clinical_safety',
                'messaging',
                'observability'
            )
        ),

    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,

    request_template JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    expected_assertions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        suite_code,
        case_code
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration_test_results (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    run_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES integration_test_runs(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    case_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES integration_test_cases(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    case_code TEXT NOT NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'passed',
                'failed',
                'skipped',
                'error'
            )
        ),

    duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (duration_ms >= 0),

    request_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    response_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    assertion_results JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,

    error_message TEXT,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        run_id,
        case_code
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_integration_test_runs_recent
ON integration_test_runs(
    started_at DESC
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_integration_test_cases_suite
ON integration_test_cases(
    suite_code,
    enabled,
    sort_order
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_integration_test_results_run
ON integration_test_results(
    run_id,
    status,
    completed_at DESC
);

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار اجرای تست یکپارچه، سناریوها و نتایج ایجاد شد.' AS message;

جدول‌های زیر را ایجاد می‌کند:
- integration_test_runs
- integration_test_cases
- integration_test_results

این Migration هیچ داده عملیاتی بیمار را حذف یا تغییر نمی‌دهد.
